name: Extraordinary Detective Marshall
source:
The year is 2008. A series of murders has been shaking up the town of East Orenji for the past two years. Will you, Detective Marshall, be able to uncover the truth behind these seemingly unconnected incidents?

[From [url=https://mkblumenau.itch.io/extraordinary-detective-marshall]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间是2008年。过去两年来，一系列谋杀案震动了东奥伦吉镇。马歇尔侦探，你能揭开这些看似无关的事件背后的真相吗？

[来自[url=https://mkblumenau.itch.io/extraordinary-detective-marshall]itch.io[/url]]
